system.description:
You find the friendly opening before a stranger finds a reason to distrust you.

Opposed by INT; affects one non-hostile NPC or Mob, excluding crawlers, bosses and elites.

upgrades.rank5: Lower-level Mobs will not attack your party unless provoked.
upgrades.rank10: A Mob up to twice your level will not attack your party unless you or an ally attacks it, or your party obstructs its objective.
upgrades.rank15: May affect a group of the same Mob type, each up to twice your level, under the same non-aggression conditions.
